title: Chick dancing
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="90" rx="30" ry="5" fill="#3a2a4a"/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <path d="M42 78 L38 88" stroke="#ff8c1a" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M58 78 L64 86" stroke="#ff8c1a" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <path d="M38 88 L30 88 M38 88 L38 92 M38 88 L44 92" stroke="#ffb347" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M64 86 L58 84 M64 86 L66 91 M64 86 L72 89" stroke="#ffb347" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="24" ry="22" fill="#ffd93b"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="66" rx="18" ry="16" fill="#ffe680"/>
  <!-- wings up -->
  <path d="M27 55 Q12 42 18 36 Q24 40 28 48 Z" fill="#ffc61a"/>
  <path d="M73 55 Q88 42 82 36 Q76 40 72 48 Z" fill="#ffc61a"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="32" r="18" fill="#ffd93b"/>
  <!-- hair tuft -->
  <path d="M47 15 Q50 6 56 8 Q53 12 52 15" fill="#ffb347"/>
  <path d="M44 15 Q44 7 49 6" fill="#ffb347"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="30" r="3.2" fill="#2b1a3d"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="30" r="3.2" fill="#2b1a3d"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="29" r="1.1" fill="#fff3b0"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="29" r="1.1" fill="#fff3b0"/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d="M46 38 L50 44 L54 38 Z" fill="#ff8c1a"/>
  <path d="M46 38 L50 41 L54 38 Z" fill="#ffb347"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="37" cy="36" r="2.6" fill="#ff9ec7"/>
  <circle cx="63" cy="36" r="2.6" fill="#ff9ec7"/>
</svg>
